sentences.text:
The present petition under Section 482 of the CrPC seeks following prayers:-
"In view of the facts and circumstances mentioned above, the petitioner~ prayed that this Hon'ble Court may be pleased to:-
a) Quash an FIR No. 85/2023 dated 24.02.2023 under Sections 376 IPC & 6 POCSO Act P.S. Chhawala, Delhi alongwith its consequential proceeding pending against the petitioner forthwith.
b) Any other or further order(s), which this Hon'ble Court may deem fit and proper in the interest of justice."
2. Learned counsel appearing on behalf of the petitioner seeks leave to withdraw the present petition.
3. Leave granted.
4. The present petition is dismissed as withdrawn and disposed of accordingly.
This is a digitally signed order.
